notes: Adds missing backend generation, API contract propagation, and cross-signal integration coverage for explainability layer.

EVAL-F5-S153.title: Generate Explainability Objects for Provider Signals
EVAL-F5-S153.description: Implement backend logic to attach explainability metadata (source, meaning, limitations) to provider credential and verification link signals sourced from provider_detail_service, ensuring each field is mapped to human-readable explanations.

EVAL-F5-S154.title: Generate Explainability Objects for Clinical Trial Signals
EVAL-F5-S154.description: Extend clinical_trials_service outputs to include standardized explainability metadata for trial phase, status, and eligibility, translating raw API fields into user-understandable meanings and clearly stated limitations.

EVAL-F5-S155.title: Integrate Explainability into EvaluateCareFacade Responses
EVAL-F5-S155.description: Update EvaluateCareFacade to aggregate explainability objects alongside evaluation signals and ensure they are consistently included in tool responses returned through the tool_router without breaking existing response structure.

EVAL-F5-S156.title: API Contract Validation for Explainability Fields
EVAL-F5-S156.description: Define and enforce Pydantic validation (or equivalent) for explainability fields in tool response models to ensure schema compliance and prevent malformed or missing explanation data from reaching the frontend.

EVAL-F5-S157.title: End-to-End Integration of Explainability Across Signals
EVAL-F5-S157.description: Validate that explainability metadata flows end-to-end across provider and clinical trial evaluations, including combined responses, ensuring no signal is returned without its corresponding explanation payload.
